findings.message: Thirteen evidence-based Chapter 1 reference-generation Markdown briefs are present and indexed in production order.

Every brief requires a finished clean black-and-white human-drawn 2D manga production sketch/reference sheet on white paper and excludes cinematic, color, photorealistic, CGI, 3D, painterly, and rough-thumbnail results.

The approved shared lead image is restricted to Daniel or Tomas identity as applicable; supporting characters have no input image, and empty environment or object briefs do not attach character artwork.

Maribel, Arturo, and Lilia remain storyboard-conditional; generated details cannot become canon without separate review and approval, and Lilia remains off-panel unless required by the approved storyboard.

Canon v002 is awaiting separate approval and relock, STORYBOARD_LOCKED and IMAGE_READY are false, image generation is disabled, and named visual dependencies do not yet exist as approved hash-bound files.
This update creates no artwork, schema-valid image job, paste-ready external handoff, asset approval, or production lock change.
